intro: This is the part of the site that’s just for us, and for the village that has been with Adam since the first night. If you came for water safety, everything you need is on the Water Safety pages, and nothing here will get in your way. If you came to see Adam, this is where he is.
videosText: Photos can’t show you what Adam says with his eyes. These can. They play from our mom’s Facebook page.

videos.title: Mom singing to Adam
videos.caption: Our mom, Shannon, singing to Adam. Her caption: “A voice only a son could love… But look at that smile!!”

videos.title: Adam and Lea in the hospital
videos.caption: Eight days after. Adam and Lea watching Barney. Mom called it “Just a sweet video of Aj and Lea watching his favorite.”

videos.title: Christmas tickles
videos.caption: Christmas morning, 2018. “May your day be full of tickles!”

videos.title: In the water with Dad
videos.caption: Adam and our dad in the water. Mom’s caption: “Yall he’s so relaxed in here, he fell asleep shortly after this video.”

villageText: Every blue shirt is somebody who showed up. Lafitte, Duncansville and everywhere in between.

familyText: Mom, Dad, Rickey, Grace, Avery, Lea and Adam. Birthdays, holidays, ball games and the bleachers.
